source.title: McGraw-Hill Ryerson Pre-Calculus 12
source.note: English titles and page references transcribed from and visually checked against the original contents. Chinese titles are matching translations. Numbered sections, chapter reviews/tests, and unit wrap-up/review/test entries are all preserved.

sections.title: 多项式函数的特征

en.title: Characteristics of Polynomial Functions
en.description: Chapter 3 · Identify and analyse polynomial functions: definitions, degree, tails, intercepts, domain and range. Includes every Investigate/Reflect prompt, Example, Your Turn, Exercises 1–13 and C1–C4, and Project Corner.

sections.description: 第三章 · 辨认并分析多项式函数：定义、次数、端行为、截距、定义域与值域；包含全部探究、例题、Your Turn、1–13、C1–C4和Project Corner。

sections.title: 余式定理

en.title: The Remainder Theorem
en.description: Unit 1 · Chapter 3 Polynomial Functions. Study long division, synthetic division and the remainder theorem, with every investigation, textbook example, Your Turn and section exercise, including C1–C3.

sections.description: Unit 1 · 第 3 章 多项式函数。学习长除法、合成除法与余式定理；包括全部探究题、教材例题、Your Turn 与节后习题（含 C1–C3）。

sections.title: 因式定理

en.title: The Factor Theorem
en.description: Chapter 3 Polynomial Functions. Includes the investigation, all textbook examples, Your Turns, Key Ideas and every section exercise, including C1–C3.

sections.description: 第3章：多项式函数。包含探究、全部教材例题、Your Turn、Key Ideas与全部节后习题（含C1–C3）。

sections.title: 多项式函数的方程与图像

en.title: Equations and Graphs of Polynomial Functions
en.description: Chapter 3: zeros, roots and intercepts, multiplicity, sign intervals, hand sketches, transformations, modelling, and every section exercise.

sections.description: 第3章：零点、根与截距，重数、符号区间、手绘图与变换，以及完整实际模型与节后练习。

sections.title: 角与角的度量

en.title: Angles and Angle Measure
en.description: Focus: sketch standard-position angles in degrees and radians, convert between the units, determine coterminal angles, and solve problems involving arc lengths, central angles, and radii. Terms: radian, coterminal angles, general form. The opening invites inspection of calculator angle units and angles in a racing car; the latter is an observation discussion with no unique numerical count. Key Ideas are incorporated into the concepts below.

sections.description: 学习目标：用度与弧度画标准位置角，互换度与弧度，求同终边角，解决圆弧、圆心角与半径问题。术语：弧度、同终边角、通式。教材开篇提醒检查计算器的角单位；赛车结构中角的数量为观察讨论，没有唯一数值。关键思想已归入以下知识点。

sections.title: 单位圆

en.title: The Unit Circle
en.description: Develop circle equations, exact unit-circle coordinates, arc lengths, rotation patterns and polar-coordinate connections.

sections.description: 建立圆方程，学习单位圆精确坐标、弧长、旋转规律与极坐标联系。

sections.title: 三角比

en.title: Trigonometric Ratios
en.description: Relate trigonometric ratios to unit-circle coordinates; determine exact and approximate ratios; identify every angle in a stated domain; solve geometric applications.

sections.description: 把三角比与单位圆坐标联系；求精确值和近似值；找出指定区间内全部角；解决几何应用。

en.title: Graphing Sine and Cosine Functions
en.description: From the unit circle to sinusoidal curves: key points, amplitude, period, scaling, and every investigation, example, Your Turn, and section exercise.

sections.description: 从单位圆到正弦型曲线：关键点、振幅、周期、伸缩，以及全部探究、例题、配套练习和教材习题。

sections.title: 正弦型函数的变换

en.title: Transformations of Sinusoidal Functions
en.description: Graph and transform sinusoidal functions; identify amplitude, period, phase shift, vertical displacement, domain and range; fit equations in degrees and radians; solve graphical models; recognize equivalent equations.

sections.description: 作图与变换正弦型函数；识别振幅、周期、相移、竖直位移、定义域和值域；由角度或弧度图像与条件建模，并识别等价方程。

sections.title: 正切函数

en.title: The Tangent Function
en.description: Unit-circle slope, tangent graphs and distance models. Includes every investigation, reflection, example, Your Turn, margin question and section exercise, including C1–C3.

sections.description: 单位圆与斜率、正切图像、实际距离模型。包含全部探究、反思、例题、Your Turn、页边问题及教材习题（含 C1–C3）。

en.title: Solving Trigonometric Equations Using Identities
en.description: Complete source questions and worked solutions. In solutions, s = sin u, c = cos u and t = tan u, where u is the current part's angle (such as x, A, B or θ), unless the question explicitly defines a different variable.

sections.description: 完整原题与逐步解析。解答中以 s = sin u、c = cos u、t = tan u 作代换，u 为当前小问的角（如 x、A、B、θ）；另有明确约定时依该题。

sections.title: 理解对数

en.title: Understanding Logarithms
en.description: A social network can model user count as an exponential function of time. Predicting the time needed to reach a given user count uses the inverse function. Understand logarithms as exponents, graph inverses, evaluate exact and estimated values, and interpret logarithmic models.

sections.description: 社交网站的用户数可用时间的指数函数模拟；反过来预测达到给定人数所需的时间，需要指数函数的反函数。本节把对数理解为指数，画反函数图，计算精确值与估计值，并解释对数模型。
